model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 勤政亲贤
evidence.excerpt_zh: 勤政親賢之東為飛雲軒東有閣為靜鑑其北為懐清芬又北為秀木佳䕃轉後為生秋庭靜鑑閣東為芳碧叢後為保合太和正殿三楹後為富春樓樓東為竹林清響（圓圓明園册）臣等謹按飛雲軒懐清芬秀木佳䕃生秋庭諸額皆御書保合太和殿壁恭懸御書聖訓四箴箴已載養心殿卷内不備録其西暖閣亦有勤政親賢額西暖閣内額曰叢雲曰養性北曰隨安室富春樓下額曰坐擁琳琅曰蔚然深秀曰無倦齋曰清風明月樓與竹林清響額皆御書
evidence.summary: East of 勤政親賢 stand 飛雲軒, the 靜鑑閣 pavilion, 懐清芬, 秀木佳䕃, 生秋庭 and 芳碧叢; then 保合太和殿 of three bays with 富春樓 and 竹林清響 behind. The note lists plaques, including a second 勤政親賢 plaque and a 隨安室 in the west warm room.

evidence.title: 生秋庭: 嘉庆六年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆六年 (1801), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 经时溽暑望秋生，风爽天澄灏气清。指日嘉音至御苑，民安稍慰旰宵萦。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 生秋庭, 1801, on escaping the heat. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 生秋庭
evidence.locator: from p.107, under 正大光明
evidence.summary: 生秋庭: 1 dated items, 1801-1801, of which 1 poems (Jiaqing); recurring themes: escaping the heat. First dated 1801, last dated 1801.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
